title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（7）：核心优化：CUDA Graph、投机推理、Overlap 与量化
description: 把前面各篇的瓶颈诊断落实到执行机制，梳理图捕获、投机验证、多流依赖、算子融合和低精度 kernel 的适用边界。

image.alt: CUDA Graph replay, speculative verification, compute-transfer overlap, fusion, and low precision.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (7): Execution: CUDA Graph, Speculative Decoding, Overlap, and Quantization
description_en: Turn the earlier bottleneck diagnosis into execution mechanisms, and state where CUDA Graph capture, speculative verification, multi-stream dependencies, operator fusion, and low-precision kernels apply.
card_title: CUDA Graph, speculative decoding, overlap, and quantization

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（6）：PD 与 EPD：阶段分离、状态传输与资源配比
description: 将编码、Prefill 与 Decode 分开建模，核算 embedding 和 KV 的传输成本，并用目标 SLO 推导资源配比与准入策略。

image.alt: Encode, prefill, and decode resource pools with embedding and KV-cache transfers.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (6): PD and EPD: Disaggregation, State Transfer, and Resource Allocation
description_en: Model the encoder, prefill, and decode separately, account for the transfer cost of embeddings and the KV cache, and derive machine ratios and admission control from the target SLO.
card_title: PD and EPD: disaggregation, state transfer, and resource allocation

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（5）：MoE 推理：Batch、DeepEP、DeepGEMM 与负载均衡
description: 沿着 batch 这条主线，分析专家覆盖率、通信量、tile 填充和负载倾斜，并用端到端实测校验理论预算。

image.alt: MoE token routing, DeepEP dispatch and combine, DeepGEMM expert execution, and load imbalance.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (5): MoE Inference: Batching, DeepEP, DeepGEMM, and Load Balancing
description_en: Follow batch size through expert coverage, communication volume, tile fill, and load imbalance, and check the analytical budget against end-to-end measurements.
card_title: MoE inference: batching, DeepEP, DeepGEMM, and load balancing

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（4）：Attention 演变：从 GQA、MLA 到混合状态
description: 从 KV 容量、每步读取量和并行可切性，理解 MLA、GDN 与压缩注意力对推理系统的影响。

image.alt: GQA shared KV heads, MLA compressed KV latent with RoPE, and GDN recurrent state.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (4): Attention: From GQA and MLA to Hybrid State
description_en: Use KV capacity, bytes read per step, and how the operator can be split to see how MLA, GDN, and compressed attention change the inference system.
card_title: From GQA and MLA to hybrid state

title: Clash-Verge设置
description_en: Setup notes for Clash Verge Rev on Windows and macOS: installation, importing a subscription, system proxy and TUN mode, Merge overrides, terminal proxy variables, routing rules, and troubleshooting.

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（3）：推理硬件：GPU、NPU 与存储层级
description: 把算力、HBM、片上缓存和互联放在同一张预算表中，理解不同硬件为什么需要不同的算子与部署策略。

image.alt: Conceptual GPU and NPU memory hierarchy: HBM, L2 cache, on-chip SRAM, and matrix compute.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (3): Inference Hardware: GPUs, NPUs, and the Memory Hierarchy
description_en: Put compute throughput, HBM, on-chip memory, and interconnect on one budget, and see why different hardware needs different kernels and deployment choices.
card_title: GPUs, NPUs, and the memory hierarchy

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（2）：分布式推理：TP、DP、EP、CP 与 PP 的取舍
description: 围绕权重、KV、激活和通信预算，推演 Attention 与 MoE 的并行组合，并分析长上下文和流水线的额外约束。

image.alt: Tensor, data, expert, context, and pipeline parallelism shown as five partitioning strategies.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (2): Distributed Inference: Choosing TP, DP, EP, CP, and PP
description_en: Reason about parallel layouts for attention and MoE from the budgets for weights, the KV cache, activations, and communication, including the extra constraints of long context and pipeline parallelism.
card_title: Parallelism is a set of system trade-offs

title: Blog Agents功能介绍
description_en: An overview of the Agents page on this blog: its hub and sub-agent architecture, the house_price_analyzer and ai_tracker agents, and the technology behind them.

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（1）：通信模型：从集合原语到跨机拓扑
description: 把集合通信拆成步数、启动时延和每卡字节数，再结合 NVLink、RDMA、NUMA 与 PCIe 拓扑解释实测差异。

image.alt: Two GPU nodes connected through NICs and RDMA, with the reduce-scatter and all-gather decomposition of all-reduce.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (1): Communication: From Collective Primitives to Cross-Node Topology
description_en: Decompose collective communication into step count, launch latency, and bytes per GPU, then use NVLink, RDMA, NUMA, and PCIe topology to explain measured differences.

title: Triton Kernel概述
description_en: Triton is a Python programming language and compiler for GPUs that simplifies writing GPU kernels without low-level CUDA or HIP knowledge.

title: 推理 INFRA 方法论（0）：Roofline：用算力与带宽建立性能预算
description: 从算术强度、硬件转折点和实际 HBM 流量出发，判断 GEMM 与 Attention 的瓶颈，并区分量化、合批和融合的适用条件。

image.alt: Roofline performance bound: bandwidth-limited slope, compute ceiling, and arithmetic intensity.

title_en: Inference Infrastructure (0): Roofline: Performance Budgets from Compute and Bandwidth
description_en: Start from arithmetic intensity, the ridge point, and measured HBM traffic to decide whether GEMM and attention are compute-bound or bandwidth-bound, and when quantization, batching, or fusion applies.

slug: 长思维链模型(Long-CoT)对AI-Infra的启发
title: 长思维链模型(Long-CoT)对AI-Infra的启发
title_en: What Long Chain-of-Thought Models Suggest for AI Infrastructure
description_en: Discusses what the O1, O3, R1, and Kimi 1.5 models imply for AI infrastructure, mainly for inference frameworks and the infrastructure layer.

title: Modern-C++_工程实践
description_en: Covers the C++ compiler and VS Code setup, build tools such as CMake, unit testing with Boost.Test and Catch2, and performance analysis with perf and Google Performance Tools.

title: Modern-C++_并发
description_en: Covers C++ multithreading with thread, mutex, condition variables, thread-local storage, atomic variables, async, and promise/future.

title: LLMs位置编码
description_en: Because a Transformer has no built-in sense of sequence, positional encoding is introduced so the model can capture positional relationships and order in the input.

title: 集群通信
description_en: A brief account of the distributed communication knowledge stack, from PCIe and NVLink through HCCS to collective communication primitives and algorithms.

title: LLMs存储
description_en: Summarizes the storage knowledge stack relevant to LLMs: multi-level cache design, cache coherence with MESI, virtual memory, and the storage hierarchy of CPU-side systems and GPUs.

title: RLHF算法以及部署概述
title_en: An Overview of the RLHF Algorithm and Its Deployment
description_en: Explains RLHF for LLMs, including its training framework (Actor, Critic, Reward, and Reference Models), the reinforcement learning and PPO algorithms behind it, and an engineering implementation based on OpenRLHF.

title: Modern-C++_STL_容器
description_en: Introduces the STL container categories, covering sequence containers, ordered associative containers, and unordered containers, along with their value semantics, storage layout, growth behavior, and complexity.

title: Modern-C++_编程范式
description_en: Walks through the five programming paradigms C++ supports (procedural, object-oriented, generic, functional, and metaprogramming) with code examples for each.

title: Modern-C++_语言基础
description_en: Covers the C++ program lifecycle, data types and keywords, memory management (heap, stack, RAII), lvalues and rvalues, pointers and smart pointers, and the basics of C++ classes.

title: LLM长文本优化策略
description_en: Explains why long context is mainly a GPU memory problem and compares sequence parallelism approaches, Ulysses and Ring Attention, including their communication volume, constraints, load balancing, and use in prefill and decode.

title: Lora&&Multi-Lora
description_en: Covers multi-LoRA training and the S-LoRA serving design for thousands of concurrent adapters: custom batched GEMM kernels, host-to-GPU adapter memory management, unified paging, and tensor parallelism.

title: Prefill Decode分离部署
description_en: Explains why prefill and decode are deployed separately, how to assess the KV cache transfer cost, and the scheduler, distributed deployment, and KV cache transfer designs in Splitwise and Mooncake.

title: SGLang-Prefix_Prompt_Cache设计
description_en: Explains how SGLang reuses prompt prefixes across requests with a prefix tree and cache-aware scheduling, and how vLLM combines PagedAttention with hash-based prefix caching, with multi-call performance results.

title: MoEs算法&&部署概述
title_en: An Overview of MoE Algorithms and Deployment
description_en: Introduces Mixture-of-Experts models (sparse MoE layers and gating networks) and the combined DP/PP/TP/EP parallelism needed to deploy them, including DeepSpeed's hybrid parallelism and TP/EP communication optimization.

title: PP&&TP LLMs部署
title_en: Deploying LLMs with Pipeline and Tensor Parallelism
description_en: Compares tensor parallelism and pipeline parallelism for LLM inference in terms of per-GPU weights, computation, activations, KV cache, and communication volume, and shows how micro-batching reduces pipeline bubbles.

title: Orca-Continuous Batching策略
description_en: Explains Orca's continuous batching, built on iteration-level scheduling and selective batching, and why static batching leaves GPU compute underused in LLM inference.

title: LLMs图编译概述
title_en: An Overview of Graph Compilation for LLMs
description_en: Explains graph-level optimization for LLMs through AI compilers, including a user-defined compiler on the TorchDynamo FX Graph (as proposed for vLLM with torch.compile), with example code.

title: 大模型推理技术栈
description_en: An index of the post series on the LLM inference stack, covering algorithms, frameworks, serving strategies, engine deployment, high-performance kernels, hardware, and long-context optimization.

title: 投机推理概述
description_en: Introduces speculative decoding with the MEDUSA multi-head approach: why decode is memory-bandwidth-bound, how extra heads and tree attention verify several tokens at once, deployment details, and measured throughput on Llama2 13B.

title: 大模型计算建模
title_en: Modeling the Computation of Large Models
description_en: Derives the parameter count, FLOPs, and GPU memory usage (weights, activations, gradients, optimizer states, and KV cache) of decoder-only Transformer LLMs during training and inference.

title: GEMM算子优化
description_en: Walks through GEMM optimization, from a naive implementation to loop reordering, tiling through shared memory in CUDA, and manual loop unrolling, aimed at better cache hit rate and parallelism.

title: LLMs量化算法概述
title_en: An Overview of LLM Quantization Algorithms
description_en: Covers quantization basics (PTQ vs. QAT, granularity, and what to quantize) and the main algorithms LLM.int8, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, and KVQuant.

title: FlashAttention系列优化
description_en: Introduces FlashAttention V1, V2, and V3 and PagedAttention as optimizations for attention score computation, covering online softmax, tiling, parallelism, FP8, and paged KV cache memory management.

title: 算子编程模型
description_en: Compares the SIMD and SIMT programming models and their GPU/XPU hardware background, using a matrix multiplication example in Ascend C and CUDA.

title: 模型部署技术概览
title_en: An Overview of Model Deployment Technology
description_en: A running outline of the offline model deployment stack: training and inference frameworks, AI hardware, and model optimization, with links to the related posts.

title: AI模型部署硬件综述
title_en: A Survey of Hardware for AI Model Deployment
description_en: A survey of GPUs (NVIDIA Hopper, Biren BR100) and XPUs (Google TPU, Ascend, Kunlun, Cambricon) used for AI model deployment, with their architectures and key specifications.

title: Goolge-TPU论文解读
title_en: In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit
description_en: Reading notes on the ISCA 2017 paper on Google's Tensor Processing Unit, covering its chip specifications, design, roofline-based performance results, the paper's discussion and conclusion, and the author's own views.

title: Transformer离线部署-GPU优化策略
title_en: Offline Transformer Deployment: GPU Optimization Strategies
description_en: The key points for optimizing the deployment of Transformer-style networks on GPU devices, based on NVIDIA's open-source FasterTransformer, covering kernel fusion, GEMM and Softmax kernel optimization, and instruction-level tweaks.

title: Bert:过去-现在-未来
description_en: An overview of the BERT family of networks covering its development history, algorithm details, and later developments such as XL-Net, ELECTRA, ERNIE, RoBERTA, ALBERT, and TinyBERT.

title: 设计模式-设计原则
description_en: An overview of object-oriented design principles: the five SOLID principles plus LoD, KISS, DRY, YAGNI, the Rule of Three, and CQS, with Python examples.

title: 设计模式-MVC模式
description_en: MVC divides a software system into Model, View, and Controller, with its class diagram, pros, use cases and extensions (MVP, MVVM), and a camera example in Python.

title: 设计模式-回调机制
description_en: The callback mechanism passes a function as an argument to another function to be run later, with its pros and cons, common scenarios, a Python template, and an asynchronous HTTP download example.

title: 设计模式-对象池技术
description_en: The Object Pool technique keeps a collection of ready-to-use objects that are borrowed and returned, contrasted with Flyweight, with its pros and cons, a Python template, and a shared power bank example.

title: 设计模式-过滤器模式
description_en: The Filter pattern removes objects that do not meet certain rules from a group of objects, with its roles, class diagram, pros and cons, use cases, a Python template, and a form sensitive-word filtering example.

title: 设计模式-解释模式
description_en: The Interpreter pattern defines a representation of a grammar and an interpreter that uses it to interpret sentences, illustrated with a simple addition and subtraction calculator in Python.

title: 设计模式-桥接模式
description_en: The Bridge pattern decouples an abstraction from its implementation so both can vary independently, compared with Strategy, with its use cases and a shape-and-color example in Python.

title: 设计模式-模板模式
description_en: The Template Method pattern defines the skeleton of an algorithm and lets subclasses supply some of its steps, with its use cases, a Python template, and a page-turning reader example.

title: 设计模式-访问模式
description_en: The Visitor pattern encapsulates operations on the elements of a data structure so new operations can be defined without changing it, with its roles, pros and cons, use cases, a Python template, and a pet shop statistics example.

title: 设计模式-享元模式
description_en: Describes the Flyweight pattern, which shares large numbers of fine-grained objects to save resources, with its roles, design points, advantages, drawbacks, use cases, and a pigment-color example.

title: 设计模式-命令模式
description_en: The Command pattern encapsulates a request as an object, with its roles, class diagram, pros and cons, use cases, a Python template, and a game-character example with macro commands.

title: 设计模式-工厂模式
description_en: The factory patterns (Simple Factory, Factory Method, Abstract Factory) create instances of different classes through a general factory class, illustrated with a whiteboard pen factory in Python.

title: 设计模式-策略模式
description_en: The Strategy pattern encapsulates interchangeable algorithms, with its three roles, class diagram, pros and cons, use cases, and a Person comparator example in Python.

title: 设计模式-适配模式
description_en: The Adapter pattern converts one class's interface into another that clients expect, with its roles, class diagram, pros and cons, a Python template, and an example adding PDF support to an e-book reader.

title: 设计模式-备忘模式
description_en: The Memento pattern captures an object's internal state without breaking its structure so it can be restored later, with its roles, class diagram, pros, use cases, a Python template, and a terminal command history example.

title: 设计模式-代理模式
description_en: Describes the Proxy pattern, which provides a surrogate that controls access to another object, with its three roles, advantages, drawbacks, use cases, a template, and a parcel-collection example.

title: 设计模式-外观模式
description_en: Describes the Facade pattern, which gives a subsystem a single unified interface, with its two roles, advantages, drawbacks, use cases, and a file compression and decompression example.

title: 设计模式-迭代模式
description_en: Describes the Iterator pattern, which provides sequential access to the elements of a container without exposing its internals, with a template and a hospital queuing-system example.

title: 设计模式-组合模式
description_en: Describes the Composite pattern, which composes objects into a tree structure to represent whole-part hierarchies, with its advantages, drawbacks, use cases, a template, and a file and folder traversal example.

title: 设计模式-构建模式
description_en: Describes the Builder pattern, which separates the construction of a complex object from its representation, with its three roles, advantages, drawbacks, use cases, and a toy-building template.

title: 设计模式-装饰模式
description_en: Describes the Decorator pattern, which dynamically adds responsibilities to an object, how it relates to Python decorators, and an example of decorating people with clothing.

title: 设计模式-职责模式
description_en: Describes the Chain of Responsibility pattern, which links receiving objects into a chain so that a request is passed along until some object handles it, with a template and a leave-approval example.

title: 设计模式-单例模式
description_en: Describes the Singleton pattern, which allows a class to have only one instance, and shows three ways to implement it: a basic implementation, a metaclass, and a decorator.

title: 设计模式-克隆模式
description_en: Describes the Prototype pattern, which creates a new object by copying an existing one through a clone method, with a template and an application-configuration backup example.

title: 设计模式-中介模式
description_en: Describes the Mediator pattern, its three roles, its advantages and drawbacks, a code template, and a device-manager example in which a mediator coordinates interactions between devices.

title: Python-常用装饰器
description_en: A collection of commonly used decorators, both the ones built into Python and its libraries (such as lru_cache, jit, dataclass, wraps, and singledispatch) and some useful custom ones (such as timing, debugging, call counting, and Singleton).

title: 设计模式-UML
description_en: Introduces UML and the six common relationships in UML class diagrams: generalization, realization, composition, aggregation, association, and dependency.

title: Transformer在CV领域的应用与部署
title_en: Applying and Deploying Transformers in Computer Vision
description_en: Covers how the Transformer works, how it is applied to computer vision tasks such as classification, detection, and segmentation, and a pointer to a separate article on deploying Transformer-style networks.

title: Python-单元测试
description_en: Covers basic unit testing with unittest, replacing dependencies with mock and patch, and how to design high-quality unit tests through test coverage and modular code.

title: Python-上下文管理器
description_en: Explains Python context managers: the with statement, class-based context managers built on __enter__ and __exit__ including exception handling, and generator-based ones using contextlib.contextmanager.

title: Python-垃圾回收
description_en: Explains Python's garbage collection mechanisms (reference counting, mark-sweep, and generational collection) and how to debug memory leaks with objgraph.

title: Python-闭包+装饰器
description_en: Introduces closures and decorators in Python, including decorators with arguments, functools.wraps, class-based decorators, and the order in which nested decorators run.

title: Python-metaclass
description_en: Explains what a metaclass is and how it dynamically changes class behavior, using the YAML object registry as a worked example.

title: 设计模式总结（Python）
description_en: A summary of the basic concepts and templates of the 23 classic GoF design patterns in Python, with a link to a detailed article for each pattern, plus object pools, callbacks, MVC, and design principles.

title: 设计模式-监听模式
description_en: Explains the Observer pattern: its concept, a Python design template with Observer and Observable classes, and a login-anomaly notification example.

title: 设计模式-状态模式
description_en: Explains the State pattern: its concept, applicable scenarios, a Python design template with Context and State classes, and a water three-state example.

title: 《流畅的Python》后记
title_en: Fluent Python Afterword: Reading Notes on Luciano Ramalho's Book
description_en: Reading notes on Fluent Python by Luciano Ramalho, covering Python's built-in data structures, function decorators and closures, object references and garbage collection, abstract base classes, and concurrency.

title: 2D_Detection-超参
description_en: Introduces basic deep learning hyperparameter settings and common tricks: learning rate strategies, optimizers, and positive and negative sample assigners and samplers for detection.

title: 2D_Detection-通用检测Tricks
description_en: Summarizes general detection tricks for three scenarios: sample imbalance, small object detection, and dense or occluded scenes.

title: 2D_Detection-Loss
description_en: Introduces the loss functions commonly used in deep learning, from classification losses and regression losses to detection losses such as Focal Loss, QFocal Loss, and IoU-based losses, covering both principles and applications.

slug: ONNX的模型优化与量化细节
title: ONNX的模型优化与量化细节
title_en: ONNX Model Optimization and Quantization Details
description_en: Introduces ONNX and ONNX Runtime, how onnx-simplifier optimizes a model through fusion and constant folding, and how to convert an ONNX model from FP32 to FP16.

title: 2D_Detection-模型加速(工程篇)
description_en: Covers engineering-side acceleration for detection models: distillation, multi-task learning, quantization with TensorRT, and operator and graph fusion.

title: 2D_Detection-模型加速(网络篇)
description_en: Covers network-side acceleration for detection models: the lightweight networks SqueezeNet, MobileNet and ShuffleNet, OneNet's NMS-free design, and network pruning.

title: 2D_Detection-经典检测框架介绍
title_en: 2D Detection: Introduction to Classic Detection Frameworks
description_en: A survey of classic 2D detection frameworks: two-stage (the RCNN series), one-stage (SSD and YOLO), and anchor-free (FCOS and CenterNet) algorithms.

slug: 数据结构与算法(Python)-优先队列&&最大(小)堆
title: 数据结构与算法(Python)-优先队列&&最大(小)堆
title_en: Data Structures and Algorithms (Python): Priority Queue and Max (Min) Binary Heap
description_en: An introduction to the priority queue (built on collections.deque) and the binary heap (the heapq module) in Python, compared on the Sliding Window Maximum problem.

slug: Jekyll博客拓展--支持Latex&&图片加速
title: Jekyll博客拓展--支持Latex&&图片加速
title_en: Extending a Jekyll Blog: LaTeX Support and Image Acceleration
description_en: How to add MathJax support to a Jekyll blog and move its images to a GitHub-based image host accelerated by the jsdelivr CDN, uploading with PicGo or git.

title: 2D_Detection-Backbone
description_en: A brief introduction to the backbone networks commonly used in 2D detection: VGG-Net, the Inception series, ResNet, and DetNet.

title: 2D_Detection-基本深度学习单元
description_en: An overview of the basic building blocks of CV networks: convolution variants, activation functions, pooling, BN/GN/FRN normalization, Dropout, fully connected layers, and receptive field calculation.

title: 2D检测算法综述(2D_Detection)
title_en: A Survey of 2D Object Detection Algorithms (2D_Detection)
description_en: An overview of the 2D_Detection series, with public datasets, a performance comparison table of classic detection papers, and links to articles on basic structure, backbone, hyperparameters, loss, classic frameworks, model acceleration, and tricks.

slug: 数据结构与算法(Python)-字符串
title: 数据结构与算法(Python)-字符串
description_en: Classic string problems solved in Python with stacks, backtracking, two pointers, and DP, plus tricks for the re module and str.format.

title: Python语言重点内容梳理
title_en: Key Points of the Python Language
description_en: An outline of a series that works through the important Python topics chapter by chapter, based mainly on the Geek Time course, with links to the chapters on data structures, closures and decorators, garbage collection, metaclass, context managers, and unit testing.

title: Python-基本数据结构
description_en: Covers Python's list, tuple, dict, and set: how lists and tuples are stored and perform, and how the hash tables behind dictionaries and sets handle insertion, lookup, deletion, and resizing.

title: Pytorch关键模块解读
title_en: A Walkthrough of Key PyTorch Modules
description_en: Walks through key PyTorch modules: autograd, BN and SyncBN, torch.utils.data, nn.Module, DP and DDP, torch.optim, torch.cuda.amp, and how a C++/CUDA extension such as non-maximum suppression (NMS) is implemented and called.

title: 基于Jekyll搭建博客
description_en: Notes on rebuilding a blog with Jekyll and Org mode on GitHub Pages: the Jekyll directory layout and config file, deployment with the Chirpy theme, comment systems (Disqus and Valine), and Google Analytics.

title: 3D单目(mono 3D)目标检测算法综述
title_en: A Survey of Monocular 3D (mono 3D) Object Detection Algorithms
description_en: A review of monocular 3D object detection methods grouped into representation transformation (BEV and Pseudo-Lidar), keypoints and shape, distance estimation from 2D/3D constraints, and direct generation of 3D proposals, followed by key takeaways.

title: Tracking算法综述
description_en: A short survey of object tracking that defines the problem, then groups traditional trackers into generative and discriminative models and lists deep learning methods.

title: OneStage经典-SSD论文精读
title_en: A Classic One-Stage Detector: Reading the SSD Paper Closely
description_en: A close reading of the Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD) paper that covers its motivation, pipeline, training details, and experimental results.

title: AVOD源码解读
description_en: A walkthrough of the AVOD codebase that covers pre-generated mini-batch anchor data and the model training pipeline, with the core code for each part.

title: F-PointNet论文解读
title_en: Frustum PointNets for 3D Object Detection from RGB-D Data
description_en: A reading of Frustum PointNets, which uses a 2D detector to obtain frustum proposals, segments the point cloud with PointNet, and estimates 3D boxes with T-Net and a box estimation PointNet, covering its motivation, pipeline, and ablations.

title: MMF论文解读
title_en: Multi-Task Multi-Sensor Fusion for 3D Object Detection (MMF)
description_en: A reading of MMF, which improves on ContFuse with an ROI-wise fusion detector head, a ground plane estimation network, and a depth completion branch, covering its motivation, pipeline, and ablations.

title: RoarNet论文解读
title_en: RoarNet: A Robust 3D Object Detection based on RegiOn Approximation Refinement
description_en: A reading of RoarNet, which obtains 3D proposals from a 2D detector, expands them with spatial scattering, and regresses 3D boxes with two-stage PointNet networks, covering its motivation, pipeline, and key results.

title: F-ConvNet论文解读
title_en: Frustum ConvNet: Sliding Frustums to Aggregate Local Point-Wise Features for Amodal 3D Object Detection
description_en: A reading of Frustum ConvNet, which splits the frustum from a 2D detection into sections, extracts PointNet features for each, and predicts 3D boxes with a fully convolutional network, covering its motivation, pipeline, and ablations.

title: Cont-Fuse论文解读
title_en: Deep Continuous Fusion for Multi-Sensor 3D Object Detection (ContFuse)
description_en: A reading of ContFuse, which fuses lidar BEV features and image features through point-wise continuous convolution fusion, covering its motivation, pipeline, and key details.

title: YOLO论文系列解读
title_en: Reading the YOLO Papers: You Only Look Once, YOLO9000, and YOLOv3
description_en: A reading of the YOLOv1, YOLOv2, and YOLOv3 papers, covering the motivation, pipeline, experimental results, and shortcomings of YOLOv1 and the improvements made in YOLOv2 and YOLOv3.

title: Numpy常用函数
description_en: A short summary of commonly used NumPy functions from the NumPy 100 exercises, grouped by array initialization, attributes, numerical methods, and array operations.

title: AVOD论文解读
title_en: Joint 3D Proposal Generation and Object Detection from View Aggregation (AVOD)
description_en: A reading of AVOD, a 3D object detection algorithm that fuses camera and lidar information, covering its motivation, pipeline, experimental results, and strengths and weaknesses compared with MV3D.

title: nms and soft-nms
description_en: Explains how non-maximum suppression removes overlapping boxes, how Soft-NMS rescores them with linear or Gaussian weighting instead, and gives Python implementations of both.

title: bash常用命令总结
description_en: A summary of common usage for the grep, xargs, sed, awk, and find commands, with examples.

title: emacs配置初步
description_en: A beginner's guide to Emacs configuration: basic key bindings, changing default settings, loading features and installing packages, and a short tour of commonly used packages.

title: Keras样例练习
description_en: Walk through Keras image examples: an MNIST MLP, CIFAR10 classification with Sequential models and data augmentation, ResNet on CIFAR10, and convolutional layer visualization with VGG16.

title: Org-mode基本功能
description_en: A short introduction to basic Org mode features in Emacs: headings, lists, tables, links, footnotes, TODO items, text formatting, source code blocks, and export.

title: Kaggle-Digit Recognizer-Dimensionality Reduction
description_en: Compares PCA (with K-Means clustering), LDA, and t-SNE for reducing and visualizing the Kaggle Digit Recognizer data, including explained variance and eigenvalue plots.

title: Kaggle-Digit Recognizer-MLP
description_en: A Keras multilayer perceptron (MLP) with two hidden layers trained on the Kaggle Digit Recognizer data, shown with its code and training log.

title: Kaggle-Digit Recognizer-DCNN
description_en: A Keras deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) for the Kaggle Digit Recognizer data, comparing linear, fully connected, and convolutional models and covering data augmentation, plus a BatchNormalization fix for Keras and tensorflow-gpu 1.12.

title: Kaggle-Digit Recognizer-svm
description_en: An SVM classifier for the Kaggle Digit Recognizer data, comparing its test score on raw pixel values with its score after the images are binarized.

title: Win7下基于Qt和opencv的程序的运行
